newsitem.title: CHINA: China river project to invite foreign tenders.
newsitem.headline: China river project to invite foreign tenders.

text.p: China's multi-billion dollar Wanjiazhai Yellow River water diversion project is expected to invite international tenders for equipment and machinery soon, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Items to be bought for the 20 billion yuan ($2.4 billion) project include six large pump stations and 44 sets of pump-motor units, with contracts for five of the pump stations and 15 of the motors open to overseas bidders, the agency said.
It gave no further details of the equipment required or of the conditions for tenders.
The Wanjiazhai project is intended to divert water from the Yellow River to industrial areas in China's northern Shanxi province and will be partly funded by the World Bank.

Project managers have already opened bidding for construction contracts to build four tunnels and an underground pumping station for the projects, prompting applications from engineering firms from 14 countries, Xinhua said in March.
